notes.title: Stay Home
notes.content:
Dear player,
until the end of the year if you reach level 50 in game, you will be able to come on our [url=https://discord.gg/freegame]Discord[/url] to collect a free giveaway for a freegame2017's game by contacting [b]Drogon[/b] admin.

Hope during this difficult time that you could enjoy to play with our fantastic community.

Friendly

Team Freegame2017

notes.title: Servers interrumption
notes.content:
Dear players,

The game is temporally unavailable, we are working on it to solve the issue as soon as possible.

We apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Summer Time change 31/03
notes.content:
Dear players,

Summer is coming, so a maintenance will be proceed the 31 March in game for the summer time change.

Start of the maintenance: 1:30 AM (in game time)
End of the maintenance: 3:30 AM (in game time)

During the maintenance servers will be unavailable.

notes.title: Opening Server 20
notes.content:
Brace yourself for the goddess Athena herself choose you to be her Champion and defeat the force of Evil.

Choose your celestial armor and become the incarnation of a zodiac sign.

Use your tremendous power to defeat your opponent.


Your journey begins the 25th January 201 at 01:00 AM (Paris time zone) with the opening of Server 20.
